title: Configure Game Defaults
description: Set the Game Default Map and GameMode for your project.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Ensure your game boots into the correct level with proper rules.

1. Open **Edit → Project Settings → Maps & Modes**.
2. Set **Game Default Map** to your main menu or first level.
3. Set **Game Default GameMode** to your custom GameMode Blueprint (if you have one; otherwise leave as None for now).
4. Also set **Editor Startup Map** (optional) to the level you want when pressing Play in editor.
5. Save. Then use **File → Package Project → Windows** to build. After packaging, launch the .exe. It should start in your designated map.

**Expect:** Packaged game opens directly into the chosen level without editor prompts.
hints: If you don't have a GameMode, create one (Blueprint Class → GameMode Base) and assign it to control player spawn and rules.
Make sure the map is included in 'List of maps to include in a packaged build' under Packaging settings.
expectedOutput: The game starts from the correct map and uses the assigned GameMode.
